extensions.name: Anikoto
extensions.description: Bundled Anikoto resolver. Skip times come from Anikoto for every provider. Quality and sub/dub come from the embed label when it states them. If a title is missing, playback tries the others and keeps your choice.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: Gotaku
extensions.description: Bundled Gotaku resolver. The HLS playlist is unwrapped on device. Variant resolution, codec, and sub/dub are reported when the playlist states them.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: reanime
extensions.description: Bundled reanime.cz resolver. Streams play in the app. The playlist reports resolution and sub or dub when it states them.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: Hello HTTP
extensions.description: Minimal BYO resolve example (template — not a live CDN). Shows optional quality, audio, and qualityRating on protocol 1.1.
extensions.author: fampep
